reviews.t: Great to get a smooth top surface and easy shape with acrylic, polygel, or hard gel.
reviews.x: I have always been a die-hard natural nail person, and I can't stand going to nail salons.  That being said, my nails like to break at inopportune times, like when I have to swatch a collection for someone.  So, I wanted to find a quick way of getting a smooth and durable nail if I desperately need one.  You can use these with acrylic, polygel, traditional hard gel ("builder" or regular), or soak-off hard gel.  I went with traditional hard gel, as I wouldn't have to worry about acrylic s

I love these dual forms.  They are very flexible and easy to use.  I used them with gel.  Although gel is a little more complicated, it was still easy to build a nail.  They have a nice c curve.  The forms popped of easily. They have their own case with all forms separated and organized.  If you are new to dual forms make sure you do your research.  They do take some practice to get it right but it’s a lot better then using the throw away forms or nail tips. They have nail length guides for easy

These Dual Forms where so easy to use and had the right amount of gap to build a strong nail. I purchased another set before and there was not a lot of room to build a stress zone, with these it was a breeze.

First time using dual nail forms. My nail plate isn't massive, but ended up being slightly too wide for these forms. The biggest size barely covered my thumb and tapers too narrow for my liking. All things considered, they are easy to use, pop off easily when the acrylic is set, and has a great arch to it. If you're the slightest bit worried they are too small, I'd suggest looking for something with more size options.

Perfect for using Gelish Polygel. The lines give you an idea of how far to extend the nail on the tip. Apply poly to inside of tip, press onto prepped and primed nails, cure for 60 seconds in the Gelish 18G, and pop off the tip. File and finish as usual!

reviews.t: I found these to be perfect for anyone who wants a square cuticle line, rather than a round one.
reviews.x: A decent product for a decent price.  These are nice and flexible, making removal super easy.  They can be reused, once you clean them and sanitize them with rubbing alcohol.  These are more square at the cuticle area, great for those with a more square shaped nail bed, my thumbs are pretty square.  They come in 10 sizes (10 of each size) and the sizes are reasonable sizing too.  I have dual forms from another brand and half of them are unreasonably HUGE, whereas these are for normal people.  Fo

reviews.t: Two sizes, I'm good with that :o)
reviews.x: Brian doesn't care about dual forms, but I do! Hi! I'm Drea, Brian's wife and I purchased these forms. :o) First let me be very clear here: THEY ARE NOT REGULAR NAIL TIPS! These are forms that give 2 uses hence the word DUAL (which means 2) These forms are for use with a product called POLYGEL. Polygel is a perfect mix of acrylic and gel products. The beauty of this marriage is that the polygel is cured in an UV/LED light. The function of the dual form, is to hold the amount of polygel you need

reviews.t: flexible, easy to remove, squarish in the cuticle
reviews.x: These are really good forms (would have given a 4.5 if that were possible), just not great for me.  My cuticle area is very round, and these forms are a bit squarish in the cuticle.  I made it work, but could not find a perfect fit, even with all of the sizes. Not the fault of the form, just that everyone has a different finger shape, and I have always had a hard time finding dual forms that fit my nails perfectly.  That aside, these forms are great as they removed very easily when I used them w

reviews.t: Dual forms make quick work of extensions or overlays
reviews.x: There has been a lot of interest lately in hybrid acrygel products and these forms really help with getting a nice set of nails! I had a corner of my thumbnail break off and got the forms just in time to try and save it rather than file it off, so I added a little bit of extra length while I was at it! I used a sheer pink acrygel and applied the product on the inside of the form - there are 10 sizes so pick the ones matching your nails before you start! There are quite a lot of video tutorials o

reviews.t: Awesome nail forms, easy as can be
reviews.x: I was really impressed with these nail forms. I bought them to use with poly gel, which they work well with. I can now easily do my nails in a lot less time. The forms come off easy and the sizing works much better then other brands. Especially nice was that I can use them also with my regular favorite builder gel! That was a surprise, but I figured try it out. Even with my regular builder gel, these dorms are easy to work with and pop right off after curing the gel. It helps that there is a sca

These dual form nail tips are perfect for creating polygel nails. They come in 10 sizes and are reusable. Clean them with rubbing alcohol to keep them in tip-top shape. Simply apply your polygel into the appropriately sized dual tip, press the polygel to the nail, cure with LED light, and then squeeze the dual form gently at the tip to release it until it pops off.  I've noticed my dual forms appear a little "cloudy" after I have reused them a few times, but they are still working well. They cre

reviews.t: Great value and great quality, has grid lines
reviews.x: I haven't actually used these yet but they look to be great quality. They are not thin or weak and they have the grid lines to help with filing to desired length evenly, I noticed not all of the forms had that. Note: these are not tips and not to be glued into your nail. I have noticed some people buying dual forms not really knowing what they are for.

They need to add some bigger sizes!  I have narrow nails and there wasn't one big enough to fit my thumb, usually a size 3 in nail tips!  And the smallest ones seem to be made for a two-year-old!  I mean, they are REALLY tiny!  I could probably extend my chihuahua's nails with the smallest size, but I don't think she'd like it.  ;-)

I am really let down by this product. This product came just like this. No plastic wrap around it, the case has been cracked in several places, and I am missing a little less than half of the product. Yes, I counted. I have 52 pieces instead of 100 pieces that the product should have in it.

These have a very pronounced c-curve and did not work on my nails or anyone else that tried them. Would work if you have very curved nails but otherwise you will end up with a pile of product on your nails and spend a lot of time filling it down to a more natural curve.

Wonderful product.. i loved them... the only down fall is the thumbs i had to do a acrylic nail with put the forms but all the other nails were done with the forms... lovely project that decreased the full set from 2 hours to 1...love them dearly❤️❤️❤️❤️

I absolutely love these duals! Beautiful C curve is achieved with no problem. Quick, easy and very durable. Just put your acrylic into the inside of the form and apply to nail, let dry and gently remove form with the two little pieces on each side!

The grid pattern on these make it really easy to get the correct length and shape. Much more accurate! I also love the natural shape of these dual forms. They pop off nice and clean.  Too. I use acrylic powders with these, and it works very well.

reviews.t: Do the job but not the best
reviews.x: I'm not in love with these dual forms. They do the job but they're very flimsy. I've had the plastic snap a few times when popping the form off my nail. They work but I'd rather use more sturdy forms that won't break on me.

reviews.t: Omg where has this been all my life?
reviews.x: So easy. I did one hand in like 10 mins while my kids were eating dinner. First time ever doing anything besides gel nail polishes. The forms are flexible and easy to use, all sizes worked for me. Extremely pleased!

I particularly did not care too much for these dual forms. If you have very small petite nail beds than this form is for you, however if you have wide/long nail beds don't bother. Product did ship on time.

Wide variety of sizes which makes it easier to fit different nails.  This makes for easy application of my gel applications and cut my time down by a significant amount.  Heavy duty and can be reused!
Very poor quality in the forms.  Not like the real dual forms at all.  Cheap plastic and the container they came in broke the first time I opened it.  Thank goodness they were not that expensive!
I use these to form the nail with poly gel.  I’m so mad I just found these!! I’ve been using the paper forms this whole time 😒 Good thing I don’t have to go back to those, and these are reusable!

reviews.t: Easy to learn and totally awesome!
reviews.x: These are awesome! Today was the first time I used builder gel and without these I am sure my attempt would have completely failed. Brilliant idea! Makes it easy to do your own nails at home.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the forms as easy to use and easy to pop off after curing.
Many reviewers find them well suited for polygel and gel applications, with grid lines and a good arch.
Several reviewers note the forms are flexible and reusable when cleaned with rubbing alcohol.
Some reviewers report sizing problems, with forms too small or too narrow for their nails, especially thumbs.
A few reviewers mention a pronounced c-curve or squarish cuticle shape that did not fit their nails.
